$comment: Sites and coins the owner has blocked. The website never links to, cites or lists them: src/lib/lamble/blocked.ts removes them from every release, edition, article and change event when it is read, including releases published before the block. The daily refresh never scrapes a blocked host and never keeps a blocked coin in poolUniverse (scripts/frames-refresh/plan.py refuses both). A host blocks its subdomains too. Add entries only on the owner's instruction, with the reason and date.
